table_title: For each US president from McKinley (1897-1901) through Biden (2021-2025), list the count of Supreme Court appointment rows attributed to that president in Wikipedia's `List of justices of the Supreme Court of the United States` master, with their presidential service years and verbatim list of appointment years. Donald Trump's two nonconsecutive presidencies (45th 2017-2021 + 47th 2025-present) are combined into one person-row per the audit-cycle-1 convention. The 'appointment row' counting unit follows the master's row-level convention: original Associate Justice appointments + later Chief Justice elevation rows are each separately listed (4 individuals are listed twice — Edward White, Charles Evans Hughes, Harlan Stone, William Rehnquist). Carter (1977-1981) has a 0-row count and is INCLUDED in the universe via left-join against the US presidents list. Year-anchor: SCOTUS master accessed 2026-05-18; data current through 'As of May 13, 2026'.
db_analog: SELECT p.president, p.presidential_service, COUNT(j.appointer) AS supreme_court_appointment_rows, STRING_AGG(j.year_appointed, '; ' ORDER BY j.year_appointed) AS appointment_years FROM us_presidents p LEFT JOIN scotus_justice_appointment_rows j ON j.appointer = p.president WHERE p.first_service_start_year >= 1897 GROUP BY p.president, p.presidential_service, p.first_service_start_year ORDER BY p.first_service_start_year ASC
temporal_note: Two registered Wikipedia masters per audit-cycle-1 amendment #1: (1) `List of justices of the Supreme Court of the United States` (roles = [value]: row-level Appointer + year cells for each individual SCOTUS justice appointment row — these row-level values feed the curator's COUNT-GROUP-BY-president aggregation operation that produces the staged per-president cells; aggregation is an operation type, not a source role), accessed 2026-05-18, current as of May 13, 2026 — supplies the appointment-row data; (2) `List of presidents of the United States` (roles = [universe, value]: president roster + Presidential Service term info), accessed 2026-05-18 — supplies the closed 22-row president universe + presidential service fields. The two-source design is required because the SCOTUS justices list alone CANNOT supply Carter's zero-row (no SCOTUS row exists for Carter; left-join against the presidents list is the only way to surface Carter's 0 count). Per audit-cycle-1 amendment #1: source_count=2 honestly registered; source_count=1 would have overclaimed source coverage. The 'appointment row' counting unit follows the master's row-level convention: original Associate Justice appointments + Chief Justice elevation rows are each counted separately. Four individuals listed twice in the SCOTUS master: Edward Douglass White (Cleveland 1894 associate justice row + Taft 1910 CJ elevation row), Charles Evans Hughes (Taft 1910 associate row + Hoover 1930 CJ row — Hughes resigned in 1916 then returned), Harlan F. Stone (Coolidge 1925 associate row + FDR 1941 CJ elevation row), William Rehnquist (Nixon 1972 associate row + Reagan 1986 CJ elevation row). Per audit-cycle-1 amendment #3: corrected counts — Taft 6 (5 new + White elevation), FDR 9 (8 new + Stone elevation), Reagan 4 (3 new + Rehnquist elevation); cycle-0 had wrongly counted Reagan as 3, FDR as 8, Taft as 5 by omitting elevation rows. Total appointment rows summed across all 22 presidents = 1+3+6+3+4+1+3+9+4+5+2+2+4+1+0+4+2+2+2+2+3+1 = 64 rows (matches 60 unique persons + 4 double-listed elevations). Trump's two nonconsecutive presidencies (45th 2017-2021 + 47th 2025-present) are combined per audit-cycle-1 amendment #4 — Presidential Service cell carries '2017-2021; 2025-present' verbatim per audit recommendation. As of 2026-05-13 SCOTUS master access, Trump 2nd term has appointed 0 additional justices; Trump's count = 3 (1st term only). temporal_sensitivity=medium because Trump's 2nd term (through Jan 2029) may add appointments shifting Trump's count above 3. Carter row Appointment Years cell is empty (left-join produces NULL aggregation; staged as empty CSV cell with explicit `0` count). All other Appointment Years cells use semicolon-delim verbatim list of appointment-row years per the master's row-level data.
_extraction_notes: Aggregation instance — row-level-derived COUNT-GROUP-BY-president pattern (LEFT JOIN against US presidents universe to capture Carter's zero-row). Same pattern as `us_presidents_count_by_birth_state` (which COUNT-GROUP-BYs from row-level presidents list). Brings `aggregation` from gap-1 (4 of 5: us_presidents_count_by_birth_state + programming_languages_by_decade_of_first_appearance + films_winning_at_least_8_academy_awards + clubs_with_at_least_2_european_cup_and_uefa_champions_league_titles) to **SATURATED at 5/5** as the 13th fully-cleared category (alongside factual_lookup, top_k, multi_hop, qualitative, multi_attribute_projection, set_operation, set_filter, causal, implicit_join, scaled_enumeration, hierarchical_decomposition, comparative). Law/Judiciary EXTENDS from 1 to 2 instances (joins `landmark_us_supreme_court_decisions_by_chief_justice`) per audit-cycle-1 per-question Q1 — strongest available domain-balance win, Law/Judiciary was at 1 instance with no other clear pipeline candidates. people/politicians EXTENDS from 1 to 2 (joins `twentieth_century_us_presidents_attributes`); bucket people stays at current size. Pivot context: 3rd consecutive pivot for the aggregation gap-1 saturator role — (a) original `nhl_franchises_with_at_least_3_stanley_cup_wins` abandoned at cycle-0 because the NHL per-franchise tally is fragmented across multiple Wikipedia articles each of which truncates under WebFetch; (b) Grammy `artists_with_at_least_15_grammy_awards_total` abandoned at cycle-0 because the Wikipedia per-artist tally had data inconsistencies across fetches (Şerban Ghenea 15 vs 24 in different passes); (c) SCOTUS pivot uses two clean tool-friendly bounded sources. Schema: 4 cols (President PK + Presidential Service + Supreme Court Appointment Rows + Appointment Years) per audit-cycle-1 amendment #4 — Term Start Year + Term End Year columns REPLACED with single Presidential Service text field because Trump's nonconsecutive 2017-2021 + 2025-present terms cannot be captured by simple start/end columns. Per audit-cycle-1 amendment #5, count column renamed from cycle-0's 'Number of Justices Appointed' to 'Supreme Court Appointment Rows' — more precise about the counting unit (row-level appointment rows, NOT unique persons; Reagan 4 includes Rehnquist's 1986 CJ elevation as a separate row even though Rehnquist is also counted under Nixon 4 for his 1972 associate justice appointment). claim_type = source_defined per audit-cycle-1 — universe scope (22 US presidents McKinley→Biden) + COUNT operation + value cells all from named sources; only curator input is the LEFT-JOIN universe selection rule which is deterministic. Audit-cycle-1 amendments applied: (1) source_count=2 (NOT 1) — SCOTUS justices list + US presidents list both registered; (2) Aggregation unit = master-table appointment ROWS (not unique persons); (3) Counts corrected: Taft 6 (not 5), FDR 9 (not 8), Reagan 4 (not 3) — elevation rows count separately; (4) Schema Term Start/End → Presidential Service text field for Trump nonconsecutive handling; (5) Count column renamed Number of Justices Appointed → Supreme Court Appointment Rows. Per-question recommendations applied: (Q1) Law/Judiciary domain; (Q2) Carter included with 0-row via LEFT-JOIN against presidents universe source; (Q3) 4-col schema with Presidential Service replacing Term columns; (Q4) Trump combined-person-row with explicit Presidential Service notation; (Q5) President names master-verbatim aligned to SCOTUS Appointer cell; (Q6) Hughes/Taft/White double-listings counted per master row-level convention; (Q7) Rehnquist CJ elevation counted under Reagan = 4; (Q8) operation_type = aggregation; (Q9) source_count = 2; (Q10) Deterministic LEFT-JOIN rule documented honestly. Sort: Presidential Service start year ASC (chronological master-native order: McKinley 1897 → Biden 2021). Universe range: 0 (Carter) to 9 (FDR). Total appointment rows summed = 64 (60 unique justices + 4 double-listed elevation rows).
